```{python}

stocks = pd.DataFrame({
  'year': [2015, 2015, 2016, 2016],
  'half':  [1,    2,     1,    2],
  'return': [1.88, 0.59, 0.92, 0.17]
})
(stocks.
  pivot(
    index = 'half', 
    columns = 'year', 
    values = 'return').
  melt(
    var_name = 'year', 
    value_name = 'return')
  )

```
